あらすじ

Sex between humans and angels provides humans with pleasure that defies all common sense. The price for this, however, is such extreme exhaustion that they can’t stand up for two or three days.

The Angel Bitches, who punish humans for their sins, have once again set out for the human city today, leading their troops.
